title: Hex
features:
Join group to get key
- Aimbot: Automatically locks onto targets with customizable aim modes (Camera, Mouse, Silent), sensitivity, and aim parts (e.g., Head, HumanoidRootPart). Includes features like random aim part selection, offset adjustments, and noise for human-like aiming.
- SpinBot: Rotates the player's character at high speeds, making it harder for enemies to hit. Customizable spin speed and spin parts.
- TriggerBot: Automatically shoots when the crosshair is over an enemy. Includes a smart mode that only triggers when aiming at a target.
- ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Visualizes enemies with boxes, health bars, names, and tracers. Customizable colors, opacity, and team-based colors.
- FoV (Field of View): Displays a customizable circle around the crosshair to indicate the range of the aimbot. Adjustable radius, thickness, and color.
- Player Checks: Advanced checks to filter targets, including team check, friend check, wall check, and more. Ensures the aimbot only targets valid enemies.
- Visual Customization: Customize the UI theme, transparency, and rendering mode for optimal performance and aesthetics.
- Configuration Management: Save and load configurations for different games, with auto-import and export options.
- Infinite Jump: Allows the player to jump infinitely, bypassing normal jump limits.
